grade-clamp interaction with existing FS.note: fsrs.ts gradeCard:85 already clamps Easy->Good on a NEW card (first exposure). A hint clamp (cap effective grade <= Hard) STACKS with this: on a brand-new card a hinted solve would be min(hintCap, firstExposureCap). Compose them as a single 'effective grade = min over active caps' — do not let the hint clamp accidentally raise a grade. The cleanest seam is to clamp the grade BEFORE it enters resultToGrade's output (cap at the call site in finish, or add an optional cap param to gradeCard). Recommend: clamp at the finish() call site (pure, testable) so fsrs.ts stays generic.
